annotations.workers/message: rollback to pinned live version (unfancy recovery, source 6dcdd25)

pre_rollback_assert.assert: active deployment must reference the NEWLY CREATED own version id (from this run's PUT response). Foreign version active -> STOP (intervening foreign deployment). Old pin still active -> SKIP rollback (the PUT never took effect or was reverted; rolling back to the old pin against itself is impossible). Never run this guard against a hard-coded pin; the own version id is runtime state.
pre_rollback_assert.also_verify_before_apply: GET .../scripts/steam-proxy/versions/6e8f4f79-f12c-4fd9-97f0-70da34d54b31 must return 200 (old version still exists).

failure_semantics: PUT failed/unchanged -> SKIP rollback (guards detect old pin still active). Unknown PUT outcome -> exactly one deployments readback to classify; still ambiguous -> STOP unverified, no repeat, no blind retry.
caveats: Rollback via pinned version deployment does NOT touch secret values.
